28/**
29 * Top-level class for the logic part of the PDF417 implementation.
30 */
31pub struct PDF417 {
32    barcodeMatrix: Option<BarcodeMatrix>,
33    compact: bool,
34    compaction: Compaction,
35    encoding: Option<CharacterSet>,
36    minCols: u32,
37    maxCols: u32,
38    maxRows: u32,
39    minRows: u32,
40}
41
42impl Default for PDF417 {
43    fn default() -> Self {
44        Self::new()
45    }
46}
47
48impl PDF417 {
49    pub fn new() -> Self {
50        Self::with_compact_hint(false)
51    }
52
53    pub fn with_compact_hint(compact: bool) -> Self {
54        Self {
55            barcodeMatrix: None,
56            compact,
57            compaction: Compaction::AUTO,
58            encoding: None,
59            minCols: 2,
60            maxCols: 30,
61            maxRows: 30,
62            minRows: 2,
63        }
64    }
65
66    pub fn getBarcodeMatrix(&self) -> &Option<BarcodeMatrix> {
67        &self.barcodeMatrix
68    }
69
70    /**
71     * Calculates the necessary number of rows as described in annex Q of ISO/IEC 15438:2001(E).
72     *
73     * @param m the number of source codewords prior to the additional of the Symbol Length
74     *          Descriptor and any pad codewords
75     * @param k the number of error correction codewords
76     * @param c the number of columns in the symbol in the data region (excluding start, stop and
77     *          row indicator codewords)
78     * @return the number of rows in the symbol (r)
79     */
80    fn calculateNumberOfRows(m: u32, k: u32, c: u32) -> u32 {
81        let mut r = ((m + 1 + k) / c) + 1;
82        if c * r >= (m + 1 + k + c) {
83            r -= 1;
84        }
85
86        r
87    }
88
89    /**
90     * Calculates the number of pad codewords as described in 4.9.2 of ISO/IEC 15438:2001(E).
91     *
92     * @param m the number of source codewords prior to the additional of the Symbol Length
93     *          Descriptor and any pad codewords
94     * @param k the number of error correction codewords
95     * @param c the number of columns in the symbol in the data region (excluding start, stop and
96     *          row indicator codewords)
97     * @param r the number of rows in the symbol
98     * @return the number of pad codewords
99     */
100    fn getNumberOfPadCodewords(m: u32, k: u32, c: u32, r: u32) -> u32 {
101        let n = c * r - k;
102        if n > m + 1 {
103            n - m - 1
104        } else {
105            0
106        }
107    }
108
109    fn encodeChar(pattern: u32, len: u32, logic: &mut BarcodeRow) {
110        let mut map = 1 << (len - 1);
111        let mut last = (pattern & map) != 0; //Initialize to inverse of first bit
112        let mut width = 0;
113        for _i in 0..len {
114            let black = (pattern & map) != 0;
115            if last == black {
116                width += 1;
117            } else {
118                logic.addBar(last, width);
119
120                last = black;
121                width = 1;
122            }
123            map >>= 1;
124        }
125        logic.addBar(last, width);
126    }
127
128    fn encodeLowLevel(
129        &self,
130        fullCodewords: &str,
131        c: u32,
132        r: u32,
133        errorCorrectionLevel: u32,
134        logic: &mut BarcodeMatrix,
135    ) -> Result<()> {
136        let mut idx = 0;
137
138        let cached_full_codewords: Vec<usize> = fullCodewords.chars().map(|c| c as usize).collect();
139
140        for y in 0..r {
141            let cluster = y as usize % 3;
142            logic.startRow();
143            Self::encodeChar(START_PATTERN, 17, logic.getCurrentRowMut());
144
145            let (left, right) = match cluster {
146                0 => ((30 * (y / 3)) + ((r - 1) / 3), (30 * (y / 3)) + (c - 1)),
147
148                1 => (
149                    (30 * (y / 3)) + (errorCorrectionLevel * 3) + ((r - 1) % 3),
150                    (30 * (y / 3)) + ((r - 1) / 3),
151                ),
152
153                _ => (
154                    (30 * (y / 3)) + (c - 1),
155                    (30 * (y / 3)) + (errorCorrectionLevel * 3) + ((r - 1) % 3),
156                ),
157            };
158
159            let mut pattern = CODEWORD_TABLE[cluster][left as usize];
160            Self::encodeChar(pattern, 17, logic.getCurrentRowMut());
161
162            for _x in 0..c {
163                pattern = CODEWORD_TABLE[cluster][cached_full_codewords[idx]];
164                Self::encodeChar(pattern, 17, logic.getCurrentRowMut());
165                idx += 1;
166            }
167
168            if self.compact {
169                Self::encodeChar(STOP_PATTERN, 1, logic.getCurrentRowMut()); // encodes stop line for compact pdf417
170            } else {
171                pattern = CODEWORD_TABLE[cluster][right as usize];
172                Self::encodeChar(pattern, 17, logic.getCurrentRowMut());
173
174                Self::encodeChar(STOP_PATTERN, 18, logic.getCurrentRowMut());
175            }
176        }
177        Ok(())
178    }

180    /**
181     * @param msg message to encode
182     * @param errorCorrectionLevel PDF417 error correction level to use
183     * @throws WriterException if the contents cannot be encoded in this format
184     */
185    pub fn generateBarcodeLogic(&mut self, msg: &str, errorCorrectionLevel: u32) -> Result<()> {
186        self.generateBarcodeLogicWithAutoECI(msg, errorCorrectionLevel, false)
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * @param msg message to encode
191     * @param errorCorrectionLevel PDF417 error correction level to use
192     * @param autoECI automatically insert ECIs if needed
193     * @throws WriterException if the contents cannot be encoded in this format
194     */
195    pub fn generateBarcodeLogicWithAutoECI(
196        &mut self,
197        msg: &str,
198        errorCorrectionLevel: u32,
199        autoECI: bool,
200    ) -> Result<()> {
201        //1. step: High-level encoding
202        let errorCorrectionCodeWords =
203            pdf_417_error_correction::getErrorCorrectionCodewordCount(errorCorrectionLevel)?;
204        let highLevel = pdf_417_high_level_encoder::encodeHighLevel(
205            msg,
206            self.compaction,
207            self.encoding,
208            autoECI,
209        )?;
210        let sourceCodeWords = highLevel.chars().count() as u32;
211
212        let dimension = self.determineDimensions(sourceCodeWords, errorCorrectionCodeWords)?;
213
214        let cols = dimension[0];
215        let rows = dimension[1];
216
217        let pad =
218            Self::getNumberOfPadCodewords(sourceCodeWords, errorCorrectionCodeWords, cols, rows);
219
220        //2. step: construct data codewords
221        if sourceCodeWords + errorCorrectionCodeWords + 1 > 929 {
222            // +1 for symbol length CW
223            return Err(Exceptions::writer_with(format!(
224                "Encoded message contains too many code words, message too big ({} bytes)",
225                msg.chars().count()
226            )));
227        }
228        let n = sourceCodeWords + pad + 1;
229        let mut sb = String::with_capacity(n as usize);
230        sb.push(char::from_u32(n).ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE)?);
231        sb.push_str(&highLevel);
232        for _i in 0..pad {
233            sb.push(char::from_u32(900).ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE)?);
234            //PAD characters
235        }
236        let dataCodewords = sb;
237
238        //3. step: Error correction
239        let ec = pdf_417_error_correction::generateErrorCorrection(
240            &dataCodewords,
241            errorCorrectionLevel,
242        )?;
243
244        //4. step: low-level encoding
245        let mut barcode_matrix = BarcodeMatrix::new(rows as usize, cols as usize, self.compact);
246        self.encodeLowLevel(
247            &format!("{dataCodewords}{ec}"),
248            cols,
249            rows,
250            errorCorrectionLevel,
251            &mut barcode_matrix,
252        )?;
253        self.barcodeMatrix = Some(barcode_matrix);
254        Ok(())
255    }

257    /**
258     * Determine optimal nr of columns and rows for the specified number of
259     * codewords.
260     *
261     * @param sourceCodeWords number of code words
262     * @param errorCorrectionCodeWords number of error correction code words
263     * @return dimension object containing cols as width and rows as height
264     */
265    fn determineDimensions(
266        &self,
267        sourceCodeWords: u32,
268        errorCorrectionCodeWords: u32,
269    ) -> Result<[u32; 2]> {
270        let mut ratio = 0.0;
271        let mut dimension = None;
272
273        for cols in self.minCols..=self.maxCols {
274            // for (int cols = minCols; cols <= maxCols; cols++) {
275
276            let rows = Self::calculateNumberOfRows(sourceCodeWords, errorCorrectionCodeWords, cols);
277
278            if rows < self.minRows {
279                break;
280            }
281
282            if rows > self.maxRows {
283                continue;
284            }
285
286            let newRatio: f64 =
287                ((17 * cols + 69) as f64 * DEFAULT_MODULE_WIDTH) / (rows as f64 * HEIGHT);
288
289            // ignore if previous ratio is closer to preferred ratio
290            if dimension.is_some()
291                && (newRatio - PREFERRED_RATIO).abs() > (ratio - PREFERRED_RATIO).abs()
292            {
293                continue;
294            }
295
296            ratio = newRatio;
297            dimension = Some([cols, rows]);
298        }
299
300        // Handle case when min values were larger than necessary
301        if dimension.is_none() {
302            let rows = Self::calculateNumberOfRows(
303                sourceCodeWords,
304                errorCorrectionCodeWords,
305                self.minCols,
306            );
307            if rows < self.minRows {
308                dimension = Some([self.minCols, self.minRows]);
309            }
310        }
311
312        dimension.ok_or(Exceptions::writer_with("Unable to fit message in columns"))
313    }

315    /**
316     * Sets max/min row/col values
317     *
318     * @param maxCols maximum allowed columns
319     * @param minCols minimum allowed columns
320     * @param maxRows maximum allowed rows
321     * @param minRows minimum allowed rows
322     */
323    pub fn setDimensions(&mut self, maxCols: u32, minCols: u32, maxRows: u32, minRows: u32) {
324        self.maxCols = maxCols;
325        self.minCols = minCols;
326        self.maxRows = maxRows;
327        self.minRows = minRows;
328    }

348        self.encoding = encoding;
349    }
